entries.prompt: Correct the FIRST generated Lava Planet mask using the SECOND image, the actual NECA LP-pred-1 photograph, as geometry/camera authority and THIRD official white catalog as coarse paint-color support (red figure far right). Keep the first image's existing recognizable burgundy face ribs, central segmented spine, dark wine eye inserts, lower sweeping cheek ridges, oval vertical-slot grille and two small pale dots. Do NOT redesign, add panels, change marks or add details. The first candidate is visibly too narrow/long compared to the photographed rigid shell and too close to the top edge. Make the whole shell broader and slightly shorter to restore the reference solid mask width-to-height ratio about0.80-0.84 (measure rigid shell only, no dreadlocks). Keep the forehead dome broad and rounded, same source photo's slight true oblique perspective, not an invented straight front or a new side. Preserve relative positions of original ribs, eyes and grille; don't stretch only the eye spacing. The lower cheek ridges end in the same real scalloped hard mask edges, no tentacles, teeth, tubes or wearer. Preserve apparent dark metallic wine/burgundy paint and restrained photo grain, slight orange light on image-left is lighting only, no orange painted stripe. No certification of unknown microdetail: keep fine relief restrained, no new glyphs or ornaments. Entire mask ONLY, on TRUE transparent RGBA, no dreadlocks/beads/head/body/neck/armor/cannon/background/scene/UI. IMPORTANT framing: center the entire solid mask at only78-80 percent of the canvas's largest axis, leaving at least10 percent fully transparent space above the highest top nub and below the lowest grille, and at least10 percent on both sides. Do not use almost-full-height framing. Exactly one mask.

Keep the same nearly frontal but slightly oblique camera and the complete mask shell from the rounded top center nub down to the scalloped lower cheek/respirator edges. The dark burgundy/oxidized wine-red metal crown has its existing narrow central vertical spine and many broad horizontal curved segmented ribs descending toward the bridge. Preserve the thick ridged outer brow edges and the narrow angular dark wine/black eye inserts. Preserve the existing sweeping hard cheek ridges and the small elongated central oval/trapezoid muzzle grille with its parallel vertical narrow slots and thick rim. Preserve the two small pale circular fastener-like dots next to the muzzle only where visible. The orange light on image-left is illumination, not an orange painted panel. Preserve existing facial ridges and grille, no added teeth, tusks, tribal glyphs or new ornaments. The red translucent organic head, bead-covered dreadlocks, side cannon and neck loops are NOT part of the rigid mask and must be fully excluded.
